title: 第23章 得意的姜凤第24章 再次打脸
content_zh:
“打断我的腿？”
张逸风笑了，笑容轻蔑，随后他毫无畏惧，继续向前，根本没有将阿虎的话放在心上。
“有种，但你是找死。”
阿虎脸色当时就变得难看，他阿虎在航阳市还是有些名气的，不少人都会叫他一声虎哥。这个小子居然无视他的存在。
冷哼一声，阿虎大步追上张逸风，巨大的手掌搭在了张逸风的肩膀，但他还没来得及用力，张逸风反手便抓住了阿虎的手腕。
轻轻一拧。
咔擦一声轻响，阿虎的手腕当场就脱臼了。
“我不喜欢陌生人同我勾肩搭背，滚！”
张逸风转过身，冷冷说了一句，便继续向前。
“好，好，有种！你们上，给我弄死他！”
阿虎脸色难看到了极点，不知道是因为疼痛，还是因为脸上无光，在这个场子里，他何时受到过这样的耻辱。
“是，虎哥！”
“小子站住！”
其他几位打手纷纷冷喝一声，拦住了张逸风的去路，其中一人手中还拿出了一把砍刀。
“不好，有人动刀子！”
“快走。”
附近正在扭动身体的人，看见有人动刀，连忙让开位置，但人群并没有离开太远，而是站在一旁看热闹。
“妈的，居然敢打我们虎哥，你小子是不是活腻了！”
“还不跪下给我们虎哥道歉，不然老子废了你！”
几位打手围住张逸风，脸色凶狠。手持砍刀的更是嚣张，直接用刀指着张逸风的脸门，一副不跪砍死你的凶狠模样。

“我再说一次，滚。”
张逸风看着几位打手，脸色依旧平淡。
“小子，你找死老子就成全你。”
拿着砍刀的人冷哼一声，随后直接朝张逸风砍了过去，当然，这人用的是刀背，估计也不想在这里将事情闹大。
“真动手了！”
“这是要将事情闹大啊。好像是肖老大的人，怪不得敢在这里动手。”
附近围观的人都是一声惊呼，连酒意都清醒了不少。
这种地方，小打小闹见多了，但动刀子砍人还是很少发生的，能开这么大俱乐部的人，自然也是有些实力和背景的。很显然，梦幻俱乐部就是其中之一，没能耐的人，怎么可能开这么大的俱乐部。
“这小伙子惨了。”
不少人摇了摇头，替张逸风捏了一把汗。
但，张逸风并没有像他们想象中的一样被汉子砍翻在地，在砍刀即将落在张逸风肩膀上的时候，张逸风动了，他猛然一个跨步，整个人便靠近了身材壮硕的打手，随后右胸口用力一撞，壮硕汉子的身体快速后退。
汉子的身体刚刚退了一步，张逸风又抓住了汉子持刀的手腕，轻轻一拧，汉子吃痛之下松开了手中的砍刀。
张逸风眼疾手快，另外一只手接住了砍刀，转身便抵在了汉子的脖子上。
只是一招，张逸风便制服了体重一百六的壮汉。
content_en:
"Break my legs?"
Zhang Yifeng smiled, with a contemptuous smile, and then he continued to move forward without fear, not taking Ahu's words to heart at all.
"Yes, but you are seeking death."
Ah Hu's face turned ugly at that time. He, Ah Hu, was quite famous in Hangyang City, and many people would call him Brother Hu. This kid actually ignored his existence.
With a cold snort, Ah Hu strode to catch up with Zhang Yifeng, and put his huge palm on Zhang Yifeng's shoulder, but before he could exert any force, Zhang Yifeng grabbed Ah Hu's wrist with his backhand.
Twist lightly.
There was a soft click, and Ahu's wrist was dislocated on the spot.
"I don't like strangers hooking up with me, get out!"
Zhang Yifeng turned around, said something coldly, and then continued forward.
"Okay, okay, I have the guts! Come on, kill him for me!"
Ahu's expression was extremely ugly. He didn't know whether it was because of the pain or because his face was dull. When had he ever been humiliated like this in this place.
"Yes, Brother Tiger!"
"Stop boy!"
Several other thugs shouted coldly and blocked Zhang Yifeng's way. One of them even took out a machete in his hand.
"No, someone used a knife!"
"Go quickly."
People nearby who were twisting their bodies saw someone using a knife and quickly moved out of the way, but the crowd did not move too far away and stood aside to watch the excitement.
"Damn it, you actually dare to hit our Brother Tiger, are you tired of living?"
"If you don't kneel down and apologize to our Brother Tiger, I will destroy you!"
Several thugs surrounded Zhang Yifeng with fierce expressions on their faces. The man holding the machete was even more arrogant. He pointed the knife directly at Zhang Yifeng's face, looking as ferocious as if he wouldn't kneel down and chop you to death.
"I say it again, get out."
Zhang Yifeng looked at the thugs, his face still calm.
"Boy, if you want to die, I will help you."
The person holding the machete snorted coldly, and then slashed directly at Zhang Yifeng. Of course, this person used the back of the knife, and he probably didn't want to make things worse here.
"Really taking action!"
"This is going to make things bigger. It seems to be Boss Xiao's people, no wonder they dare to take action here."
The nearby onlookers all exclaimed, and even their drunkenness had sobered up a lot.
We see a lot of small fights in places like this, but it's rare to kill someone with a knife. People who can open such a big club naturally have some strength and background. Obviously, Dream Club is one of them. How can an incompetent person open such a big club?
"This young man is miserable."
Many people shook their heads and sweated for Zhang Yifeng.
However, Zhang Yifeng was not chopped to the ground by the man as they imagined. Just when the machete was about to fall on Zhang Yifeng's shoulder, Zhang Yifeng moved. He suddenly took a step forward and approached the strong thug. Then he hit his right chest hard, and the strong man's body quickly retreated.
Just as the man took a step back, Zhang Yifeng grabbed the man's knife-holding wrist and twisted it gently. The man let go of the machete in pain.
Zhang Yifeng had quick eyes and quick hands. He caught the machete with his other hand, turned around and put it against the man's neck.
With just one move, Zhang Yifeng subdued the strong man weighing 160.
